answer: What profit in ten masks when one player stands true? At the wharf, every mask must carry its own quartz ledger — a memory-hard chain where each proof is forged only in sequence, never in parallel, and bound to seasons no coin can buy. Split your stake across ten fresh masks and each starts at zero: ten ledgers, tenfold the waiting, a tenth of the voice. One opal of honest tenure, one mask, keeps the wage its own seasons earned.
